notes:
Ports: 25/tcp (SMTP), 587/tcp (submission/STARTTLS), 465/tcp (SMTPS)
Commands: HELO, EHLO, AUTH PLAIN, MAIL FROM, RCPT TO, DATA, RSET, VRFY, EXPN, NOOP, QUIT, STARTTLS
Open relay misconfig (Postfix): mynetworks = 0.0.0.0/0

recommended.note: Connect via telnet and test VRFY, open-relay via nmap
